findings.evidence: `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` exits 2 with the single report: `docs/evaluation/test-gate-k-eval-tooling-lib.sh:321: new blank line at EOF.` The file ends with `}` followed by an empty line (two trailing newline characters), which is a repo whitespace-error gate failure introduced by this branch. Because the audit acceptance rule is zero findings with every required command passing, this one command failure prevents an overall pass even though it is a cosmetic/whitespace defect with no behavioral impact.
